title: How Phone Scams Actually Work — Two True US Stories

episode.title: "The $400,000 Machine: How US Phone Scams Are Actually Built"
episode.description: "Two true stories. One machine. How the grandparent bail call and the fake trading app are built — the call centers, the spoofed numbers, the innocent couriers, and the one question that stops all of it."

rows.vo: "Seventy-two thousand. That's how many times Americans pick up this exact kind of call, every single day. And every one of those calls was built."
